quests.instruction: Compare the ground from yesterday to how it looks right now.
quests.hint: Compare the ground from yesterday to how it looks right now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once soft white flakes cover every yard, the weather has turned snowy.
quests.funFact: Weather can shift quickly, turning bare ground white in just one night of snowfall.
quests.wordExample: Soft white flakes covered every yard, turning the day snowy.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what lit up the yard for a split second.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what lit up the yard for a split second.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A split-second flash that lights up the whole yard describes lightning.
quests.funFact: Moving indoors quickly after seeing a flash is one of the best ways to stay safe.
quests.wordExample: A split-second flash of lightning lit up the yard.

quests.instruction: Compare the air from this morning to how it feels right now.
quests.hint: Compare the air from this morning to how it feels right now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once branches whip and leaves swirl everywhere, the weather has turned windy.
quests.funFact: Weather can shift from calm to windy in just a short while as air pressure changes.
quests.wordExample: Branches whipped and leaves swirled, turning the day windy.

quests.instruction: Notice how the sky looks different now compared to this morning.
quests.hint: Notice how the sky looks different now compared to this morning.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once patches of blue show between drifting clouds, the weather has turned partly cloudy.
quests.funFact: A fully cloudy sky can break apart into a partly cloudy sky as the day warms up.
quests.wordExample: Patches of blue appeared between clouds, turning the sky partly cloudy.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to how the leaves and air changed compared to last month.
quests.hint: Pay attention to how the leaves and air changed compared to last month.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Orange leaves and crisp mornings signal that autumn has arrived.
quests.funFact: The change from summer to autumn can take just a few weeks in many places.
quests.wordExample: Orange leaves and crisp mornings announced that autumn had arrived.

quests.instruction: Think about what the wet ground turned into after freezing.
quests.hint: Think about what the wet ground turned into after freezing.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once puddles freeze hard and shiny, the weather has turned icy.
quests.funFact: Temperatures dropping quickly after sunset can turn wet ground icy within an hour.
quests.wordExample: The wet ground froze hard and shiny, turning the path icy.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what Noah and Ivy decide to do about the storm.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what Noah and Ivy decide to do about the storm.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Closing the curtains and reading together describes staying inside.
quests.funFact: A cozy indoor activity can make waiting out a storm feel much less worrying.
quests.wordExample: Roaring wind and booming thunder meant staying inside was best.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what changed between lunchtime and now.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what changed between lunchtime and now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once the air feels light and crisp after being warm, the weather has turned cool.
quests.funFact: Afternoon warmth often fades into cool, crisp air as evening approaches.
quests.wordExample: The warm afternoon turned cool and crisp by evening.

quests.instruction: Think about the season with orange leaves that some English speakers call fall.
quests.hint: Think about the season with orange leaves that some English speakers call fall.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Orange leaves during the season some call fall describe autumn, also known as fall.
quests.funFact: Writing to pen pals in different countries can teach you new words for familiar things.
quests.wordExample: The pen pal described fall, with its orange leaves.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to how the trees and air changed compared to last month.
quests.hint: Pay attention to how the trees and air changed compared to last month.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Bare trees turning green with singing birds signal that spring has arrived.
quests.funFact: The change from winter to spring can take just a few weeks in many places.
quests.wordExample: Green trees and singing birds announced that spring had arrived.

quests.instruction: Think about the item Ana is glad they packed for rain like this.
quests.hint: Think about the item Ana is glad they packed for rain like this.
quests.explanation: Great choice! The item opened over your head to block falling rain is an umbrella.
quests.funFact: Packing an umbrella even on a partly cloudy day can be a smart habit.
quests.wordExample: They were glad they packed an umbrella for the sudden rain.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to how the ground and air changed compared to last month.
quests.hint: Pay attention to how the ground and air changed compared to last month.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Snow-covered ground with foggy breath signals that winter has arrived.
quests.funFact: The change from autumn to winter often brings the year's first snowfall.
quests.wordExample: Snow-covered ground and foggy breath announced that winter had arrived.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what changed between this morning and now.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what changed between this morning and now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Dark clouds and tapping drops mean the weather has turned rainy.
quests.funFact: Weather can change quickly, turning from clear to rainy in just an hour.
quests.wordExample: Dark clouds rolled in, and the day turned rainy.

quests.instruction: Compare the sky from this morning to the sky right now.
quests.hint: Compare the sky from this morning to the sky right now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once soft grey shapes spread across the whole sky, the weather has turned cloudy.
quests.funFact: Weather can shift from sunny to cloudy in under an hour as clouds move in.
quests.wordExample: Grey shapes spread across the sky, turning the day cloudy.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what changed between breakfast and now.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what changed between breakfast and now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once the air feels gentle and pleasant after being chilly, the weather has turned warm.
quests.funFact: Morning chill often fades into warm, pleasant air by midday as the sun rises higher.
quests.wordExample: The chilly morning turned warm and pleasant by midday.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what changed between an hour ago and now.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what changed between an hour ago and now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once the wind roars and thunder keeps booming, the weather has turned stormy.
quests.funFact: Calm, cloudy weather can build into a stormy system in under an hour.
quests.wordExample: The wind roared and thunder boomed, turning the day stormy.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what changed between waking up and now.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what changed between waking up and now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once a soft grey mist rolls in and hides the garden, the weather has turned foggy.
quests.funFact: Fog can roll in quickly, especially near rivers, lakes, and coastlines.
quests.wordExample: A soft grey mist rolled in, turning the morning foggy.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to how the mornings and daylight changed compared to last month.
quests.hint: Pay attention to how the mornings and daylight changed compared to last month.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Hot mornings with long, stretching days signal that summer has arrived.
quests.funFact: The change from spring to summer often happens gradually as daylight keeps increasing.
quests.wordExample: Hot mornings and long days announced that summer had arrived.

quests.instruction: Notice what Ben says changed between this morning and now.
quests.hint: Notice what Ben says changed between this morning and now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once the air turns sharp and icy with picking wind, the weather has become cold.
quests.funFact: Wind can make cold air feel even colder against your skin.
quests.wordExample: The air turned sharp and icy, making the day cold.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what Sam and Mia are preparing to do with their towels.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what Sam and Mia are preparing to do with their towels.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Warming water that is finally ready for jumping in describes going swimming.
quests.funFact: Water in a pool or lake often takes longer to warm up than the air above it.
quests.wordExample: Warm water finally made going swimming possible.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what Omar and Priya are preparing to pack.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what Omar and Priya are preparing to pack.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Calm breeze and warm sun perfect for packing a basket describes having a picnic.
quests.funFact: A calm, mild day is often the best choice for enjoying food outdoors.
quests.wordExample: Calm breezes finally made having a picnic possible.

quests.instruction: Notice how Ben describes the change from this morning to now.
quests.hint: Notice how Ben describes the change from this morning to now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once the air turns heavy and warm under strong sun, the weather has become hot.
quests.funFact: Temperatures often rise several degrees between early morning and afternoon on a hot day.
quests.wordExample: The air turned heavy and warm, making the day hot.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what changed between morning and now.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what changed between morning and now.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Once every cloud disappears and the light is strong, the weather is sunny.
quests.funFact: Weather can change from cloudy to sunny in just a few hours as clouds move away.
quests.wordExample: Every cloud disappeared, leaving a perfectly sunny sky.

quests.instruction: Pay attention to what Ravi describes seeing in the sky.
quests.hint: Pay attention to what Ravi describes seeing in the sky.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Red, orange, and every color arching across the sky describes a rainbow.
quests.funFact: Around the world, many cultures have their own special stories about rainbows.
quests.wordExample: Red, orange, and every color arched into a bright rainbow.

quests.instruction: Think about what a snowflake symbol on a forecast usually means you should prepare.
quests.hint: Think about what a snowflake symbol on a forecast usually means you should prepare.
quests.explanation: Correct! A snowflake symbol with several expected inches means you should prepare warm clothes for snowy weather.
quests.funFact: Many families keep a shovel and warm boots ready before a big snowy forecast.
quests.wordExample: The snowflake symbol meant tomorrow would be snowy.

quests.instruction: Think about what a bolt-in-a-cloud symbol with an alert usually means your family should avoid.
quests.hint: Think about what a bolt-in-a-cloud symbol with an alert usually means your family should avoid.
quests.explanation: Correct! A bolt symbol with a safety alert means your family should avoid outdoor activities because of lightning.
quests.funFact: Safety alerts about lightning help families know exactly when to head indoors.
quests.wordExample: The bolt symbol reminded the family to stay indoors because of the lightning.

quests.instruction: Think about what a swirl symbol with strong gusts usually means you should do.
quests.hint: Think about what a swirl symbol with strong gusts usually means you should do.
quests.explanation: Correct! A swirl symbol with strong gusts means you should secure loose items for windy weather.
quests.funFact: Forecasters give wind speeds in miles or kilometers per hour to show how windy it will be.
quests.wordExample: The swirl symbol reminded us to prepare for windy weather.

quests.instruction: Think about what a sun-behind-a-cloud icon usually means for the sky.
quests.hint: Think about what a sun-behind-a-cloud icon usually means for the sky.
quests.explanation: Correct! A sun peeking out from behind a cloud icon means you should expect a partly cloudy sky.
quests.funFact: Forecast icons combine a sun and a cloud together specifically to show partly cloudy weather.
quests.wordExample: The sun-behind-cloud icon meant a partly cloudy sky.

quests.instruction: Think about which season sits between a hot month and a freezing month.
quests.hint: Think about which season sits between a hot month and a freezing month.
quests.explanation: Correct! The season between a hot, sunny month and a freezing month is autumn.
quests.funFact: Calendars often use pictures of falling leaves or pumpkins to represent autumn months.
quests.wordExample: The calendar showed autumn between the sunny and snowy months.

quests.instruction: Think about what a road symbol with ice-crystal marks usually means for drivers.
quests.hint: Think about what a road symbol with ice-crystal marks usually means for drivers.
quests.explanation: Correct! A road symbol with ice-crystal marks means your family should drive slowly and carefully because of icy conditions.
quests.funFact: Ice warnings help drivers slow down before reaching a dangerously slippery road.
quests.wordExample: The ice-crystal symbol reminded the family to drive slowly on the icy road.
